body: @mikelorant Thank you for the thorough troubleshooting and digging into this. We'll take a look at it

So I did a little bit of digging and based on the linked discussion list, it looks like our gRPC version (1.2.1) might not have the server-side connection management (see https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/pull/1119), so Tiller might be holding on to the PortForward connection from `helm`. Haven't validated it for sure, but that may help
As a note, we are closing the `PortForward` from the `helm` side based on what I was seeing in the code
